note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Zhonglian Green Big Data Industrial Base Phase 3 (中联绿色大数据产业基地三期), Longquan Town, Yanggao County, Datong, Shanxi (builder Shanxi Zhongyun Zhigu Data Technology Co., Ltd., 山西中云智谷数据科技有限责任公司)
entries.reason: In-window records are ancillary. The Datong EEB approved the EIA report form of the Phase 3 220 kV substation (3 x 150 MVA, distribution building, accident oil pool) on 8 September 2026, ref. 同环函（服务）辐〔2026〕32号. The approval says the substation is built inside the base, on reserved land of Phase 3 (local dt/dt-3c5f543f4c.html and zl3-sub-approval-20260908.doc, sha256 e0a7925e...). The EEB also proposed approval on 1 September (dt-4e0229ab72.html). The Phase 3 220 kV line EIA (Yanggao to Zhonglian I loop-in) was accepted on 1 September (dt-63d64720fd.html) and approved on 28 September 2026 (dt-8337c94867.html). Its public report link (website-webapp/ewebeditor path) returns HTTP 404. The 28 September notice's attachment is a misattached, unrelated penalty decision that contains personal data; it was not used and its raw capture was deleted. The July 2026 publicity copy of the substation report (china_west_north capture dt-eia-202607-e508.pdf) blanks the centre coordinate. None of the 31 Yanggao-branch EIA notices since February 2024 (local dtyg/) or the 33 Datong planning notices of 2026 (local dtzr/) names the base. www.yanggao.gov.cn fails to connect. No record of the data-centre buildings themselves (planning permit, completion or operation) was found, and the thirty-fourth holds rule ancillary approvals out as status evidence.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within the window) primary record of the data-centre base or its Phase 3 buildings (planning or construction permit, completion acceptance or an operator or government operating statement), plus an unredacted coordinate or a georeferenceable official plan, for example an unredacted copy of the Phase 3 substation or line report.

entries.candidate: Zhengzhou Zhengdong New District Computing Power Industrial Park Phase 1 infrastructure project (郑州市郑东新区算力产业园(一期)基础设施建设项目), south of Mingde Street and east of Longhu Zhonghuan East Road, Zhengzhou, Henan
entries.reason: Not a data centre. The Zhengdong branch of the Zhengzhou natural-resources and planning bureau issued construction-engineering planning permit 建字第4101052026GG0041665（建筑）号 on 20 August 2026 and announced it on 27 August 2026 (local zd/zd-slcyy-ghxk-20260827.html; attachment zd-slcyy-ghxk-20260827-attach.rar, sha256 afad37c5...). The permit annex classifies the buildings as 产业用房 (industrial space): 249,173.36 m2 in total, including 174,308.57 m2 of R&D space. It covers three to four 12-storey towers and six 5-storey buildings, with commercial, property-management and substation rooms and only telecom access rooms of about 50-150 m2. No machine-room or data-hall building is listed. The 20 July 2026 scheme consultation (zd-slcyy-fa-20260720.html) shows the same office-park layout. Builder: Zhengzhou Zhengchuang Science Park Management Service Co., Ltd.
entries.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a primary source identifies a distinct data-centre or machine-room building in the park, with its own status and locator.

entries.candidate: Boda Data Langfang No. 1 intelligent computing base (博大数据廊坊一号智算基地), Langfang, Hebei (build-and-maintain facility for JD.com)

entries.candidate: Sinnet (光环新网, 300383.SZ) data centres in Tianjin and Hebei: Tianjin Baodi (宝坻数据中心, Jing-Jin Zhongguancun Science City), Tianjin Guanghuan Zanpu (Bolong Lake, Binhai), Yanjiao (燕郊, Sanhe, phases 1-4); and Beijing: Fangshan (Doudian), Zhongjin Yunwang (BDA), Kexin Shengcai (BDA), Jiuxianqiao and BDA
entries.reason: None of these Sinnet facilities is in the Atlas. The 2026 interim report summary on Sinnet's disclosure page (local op/sinnet-2026h1-summary.pdf, sha256 3a6648c6...; created 26 August 2026, uploaded 1 September 2026) states the following. Tianjin Baodi phase 1 entered full production in 2025 and phase 2 was fully delivered by 30 June 2026. Baodi currently (目前) has more than 30,000 racks in production. Yanjiao phases 1-2 are in production and phases 3-4 are partly delivered. The five Beijing data centres 'operated stably in the reporting period'. The same file (same SHA-256) is the cninfo filing of 27 August 2026 (static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-08-27/1225510323.PDF), so the Baodi present-tense statement is in the window. The Beijing statements cover the January-June period, outside the window. The earlier asia round-6 packet (2026-09-08) excluded Baodi Phase II as a completed phase and held Yanjiao. Sinnet's directory (op/sinnet-dc.html) gives only text locations and a raster map. Tianjin hosts answer HTTP 403, Hebei hosts fail to connect, and no EIA, planning or coordinate source was found.
entries.reopen_condition: A sourced locator for a named Sinnet campus (official parcel, EIA or planning coordinate, or an operator marker with known datum). Tianjin Baodi could then be admitted as operational from the 27 August 2026 filing until about 20 November 2026 (85-day window), or later with a newer record.

entries.candidate: Hebei Artificial Intelligence Computing Center (河北人工智能计算中心), Langfang, Hebei
entries.reason: The Hebei Daily report of 12 October 2026, republished by the Hebei Cyberspace Administration (www.caheb.gov.cn/system/2026/10/12/030398156.shtml; local ca/caheb-030398156.html), quotes the centre's head. The centre plans 300P and has 100P online, with monthly utilisation steady above 95%, and the report says it has operated since October 2023. This is a public compute platform; its commercial or institutional character is still to be confirmed. No parcel, address point, EIA or planning coordinate was found, and Langfang hosts answer HTTP 403.
entries.reopen_condition: A sourced locator for the centre's building or campus, and confirmation that it is a commercial or public-service data centre rather than a standalone institutional system.

entries.candidate: Haoyang Langfang No. 2 Data Center Park (皓扬廊坊2号数据中心园区), Gu'an County, Langfang (Beijing Haoyang Cloud Data Technology Co., Ltd.)

entries.candidate: Haoyang Langfang No. 1 Existing Operations: status refresh from the Hebei Daily report of 12 October 2026
entries.reason: Not used as a refresh. In the 12 October report, the quoted vice-president speaks only about chip power density and the company's green-design priorities. The existing record is already operational as of 13 August 2026. Haoyang's own news item on the Phase 2 Building B topping-out ('10月8日') carries no year and is listed among 2024 items.

entries.candidate: Empyrion Digital TW1, Neihu, Taipei (7 MW IT, 5-storey colocation data centre)
entries.reason: Empyrion's release of 25 August 2026 (local empyrion-tw1-financing.html; datePublished 2026-08-25) says it closed financing with E.Sun Bank for TW1, its 7 MW data centre in Neihu, and that the financing underpins TW1's continued development: an in-window company disclosure that supports announced (the 13 January groundbreaking is outside the window and the August release describes no physical work). No source gives TW1's street address, lot or a map marker: the TW1 page, the Taiwan page, the November 2024 entry release and the groundbreaking release name only the Neihu district, and the page links no TW1 factsheet. A district is not an admissible locator.
entries.reopen_condition: A Taipei City building-permit, urban-design-review or green-building record, or an Empyrion page or factsheet, that gives TW1's address or lot; then the official Taipei house-number point (local_data/country-research-2026-10-16-korea_taiwan/taipei-house-number-points-20261002.csv) and the 25 August observation while it is within the window (until 18 November 2026 for the 85-day brief window).

entries.candidate: BDx HKG8, 38 Wing Kei Road, Kwai Chung: new data-centre floors 12/F, 15/F and 16/F with ancillary fuel-tank and fan rooms (TPB A/KC/515, approved with conditions 9 October 2026)

A new project at the existing site is not expressible: BDx HKG8's locator is project_locator scoped (official_landsd_single_building_lot_centroid), and the builder only adds projects at sites with a campus_locator. Both TPB documents are already attached to the HKG8 project as identity context, and the operating project's status cannot be moved to permitted.
